items.title: Pakistan has Portugal's 'full support' for GSP+ status, visiting FM says during delegation-level talks in Islamabad
items.description:
Pakistan has Portugal’s “full support” for the European Union’s (EU) GSP+ status, Portuguese Minister of State and Foreign Affairs Paulo Rangel said on Monday during Pakistan-Portugal delegation-level talks held in Islamabad.
Pakistan’s current GSP+ status is set to expire in 2027, after which Islamabad will seek a renewal.
GSP+ status is a special incentive awarded to developing countries to “pursue sustainable development and good governance” in exchange for cutting import duties to zero on two-thirds of the tariff lines of its exports.

items.description:

items.description:
